description: Actual dialogue choice, manual save UI, confirmation/load UI, and repeat interaction on six isolated deterministic prechoice fixtures. This is branch UI/persistence verification, not a fresh campaign progression claim.

fixture.source: Earned full campaign snapshot; only this arc rewound to an explicit prechoice fixture.

intro.speaker: Countervoice
intro.text: I agreed to preserve the dying. Not to imprison the living. If my own voice is used to command them, let it end.

intro.speaker: Vex
intro.text: It’s her. Not a recording. A small piece of her, caught in the system. She asks me to choose.

intro.speaker: Kaida
intro.text: You don’t owe me the answer. I’m staying beside you either way.

choiceButtons: Preserve the voices as free witnesses.
Honor her request and release the echoes.

conclusion.speaker: Vex
conclusion.text: We will keep the voices, but remove their authority. Witnesses. Never commands.

conclusion.speaker: Countervoice
conclusion.text: Then you have understood the part I could not finish.

conclusion.speaker: Vex
conclusion.text: I spent years defending who I needed her to be. I think I’m ready to listen to who she was.

revisit.speaker: Vex
revisit.text: The voices are free to speak. We are free to answer.

conclusion.speaker: Countervoice
conclusion.text: My bright, difficult child. Thank you.

conclusion.speaker: Vex
conclusion.text: Silence used to frighten me. This one feels like a door opening.

revisit.speaker: Vex
revisit.text: She is at rest. Let the living have this room.

intro.speaker: Charter
intro.text: The sentinel shall preserve the people, their freedom, and the right to return. No command shall stand above these.

intro.speaker: Rune
intro.text: They cut the second half from the oath they taught us.

intro.speaker: Kaida
intro.text: You still get to decide what to carry.

choiceButtons: Carry every name. Remember the cost of command.
Write a living oath. Keep every door open.

conclusion.speaker: Rune
conclusion.text: I will carry all thirty-one names. A command is a choice, and its cost is mine to remember.

conclusion.speaker: Kaida
conclusion.text: You don’t have to carry them without us.

conclusion.speaker: Rune
conclusion.text: I know. That is the new part.

revisit.speaker: Rune
revisit.text: The oath is complete. So is the part I choose to keep.

intro.speaker: Mara
intro.text: You found her words. “Making home larger.” That sounds like Tavi.

intro.speaker: Mara
intro.text: The receiver southeast of the Exchange could reach her signal.

intro.speaker: Mara
intro.text: We have enough hands to start one thing properly. A trade route to keep supplies moving, or open houses where no traveler pays for shelter. Which promise should this convoy make?

choiceButtons: Connect the settlements with a shared trade route.
Build free lantern houses for every traveler.

conclusion.speaker: Mara
conclusion.text: Then every wagon carries something for the next settlement. Nobody rebuilds alone. The traders have agreed to lower their prices for your crew.

revisit.speaker: Mara
revisit.text: The caravan receiver southeast of here can find Tavi. We will follow her signal.
